description: Estimate personal income tax and take-home pay from gross annual income for 57 countries, using the engine's effective-dated brackets with each country's own levies, offsets and social contributions as its scheme defines them. Covered: AE, AR, AT, AU, BD, BE, BR, CA, CH, CL, CN, CO, CR, CZ, DE, DK, EE, EG, ES, FI, FR, GB, GR, GT, HU, ID, IE, IL, IN, IS, IT, JM, JP, KE, KR, LU, LV, MX, MY, NG, NL, NO, NZ, PH, PK, PL, PT, SA, SE, SG, SI, SK, TH, TR, US, VN, ZA. Any other country returns 'not covered' rather than a guess; its headline rates live in tax_rate_lookup. Pass region for a state, province or nation where the scheme has one (CA: 13 regions, e.g. AB, BC, MB; ES: 3 regions, e.g. AN, CT, MD; GB: SCT (Scotland); US: 51 regions, e.g. AK, AL, AR); without it the answer is national only and says so in its assumptions. For Finland pass `municipality` (Finnish or Swedish name, e.g. 'Tampere' or 'Helsingfors') for that municipality's own rate — otherwise the national average is used and the answer says so — plus `church` for a parish member and `age` where it changes the contributions; Finland also returns the tax-card rate (veroprosentti). This is a resident-individual estimate, not a filing calculation: relay the assumptions it returns. Each answer cites the income-tax source and date for that country — not the GST/VAT one. For AU HELP/HECS use student_loan_repayment.

age.description: Finland only: age at the end of the tax year. Changes the employee pension and unemployment contributions and, from 66, the earned-income credit; omit to assume a working age of 18–52

church.description: Finland only: parish membership, for church tax. Needs `municipality`, because each parish sets its own rate

country.description: 2-letter ISO code of a covered country (upper case)

income.description: Gross annual income in local currency, before tax

municipality.description: Finland only: the municipality (kunta) of residence on 31 December of the previous year, in Finnish or Swedish, e.g. 'Helsinki', 'Espoo', 'Tampere', 'Åbo'. Sets the municipal and parish tax rates; omit to use the national average municipal rate

region.description: Optional state, province or nation code, where the country's scheme has one: CA: 13 regions, e.g. AB, BC, MB; ES: 3 regions, e.g. AN, CT, MD; GB: SCT (Scotland); US: 51 regions, e.g. AK, AL, AR

taxYear.description: Tax-year label as the country uses it, e.g. '2025-26' (AU/NZ/GB/IN) or '2026' (calendar-year countries); omit for the current tax year. An unknown year is refused with the years on file

name: income_tax_estimate

assumptions.description: Assumptions the figures depend on — relay them with the numbers

averageRate.description: Total tax over gross, as a fraction

churchRate.description: Finland: church-tax rate applied, as a fraction (0 for a non-member)

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

incomeTax.description: Income tax before levies and offsets

levies.description: Charges on top of the offset tax, by name (social contributions, regional tax) — empty array when none apply

lito.description: Kept for compatibility: AU Low Income Tax Offset only, 0 for every other country. See `offsets` for the general figure.

marginalRate.description: Marginal rate on the next unit of income, as a fraction

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

medicareLevy.description: Kept for compatibility: AU Medicare levy only, 0 for every other country. See `levies` for the general figure.

municipalRate.description: Finland: municipal income-tax rate applied, as a fraction

municipality.description: Finland: the municipality whose rates were used, or "national average"

offsets.description: Credits that reduced the tax, by name — empty array when none apply

region.description: State, province or nation whose tax was included — present only when region was passed

separatelyWithheld.description: Finland: employee pension and unemployment contributions for the year, to the cent — withheld by the employer on top of the tax card

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

taxCardRate.description: Finland: the withholding percentage (veroprosentti) Vero would put on the tax card — rounded up to the next half point. Employee pension and unemployment contributions are withheld on top of it

taxCardWithheld.description: Finland: the tax the tax card covers for the year, to the cent (state, municipal, church, health insurance and YLE tax, less the credit)

taxYear.description: Tax year the brackets belong to

taxable.description: Income after any pre-band deduction (UK personal allowance, IN standard deduction, US standard deduction)

totalTax.description: Total tax after levies and offsets

title: Income tax & take-home estimate (57 countries)
